title: Engraved line from a circle
description: A 16.5 x 16 mm circle converted to an engraved line: a needle point wherever a fill stitch crosses the line. PE-DESIGN 11.50 adds 118 needle points, on a ring about 1 mm inside the circle (the inner edge of its 2 mm zigzag line); OpenStitch adds 142, on the circle itself.

evidence.note: PE-DESIGN 11.50 round-10 capture 471-engraved-line-circle.pes (SHA-256 ce29d0ecf546293e3356c3d9b69100bdad98e9253382cf3f956a44edaafc6197, 3369 stitches; the owner's, not in the repository until PES 0110 import reads a shape that carries a stamp), measured for #471

measurements.evidence: 3,574 stitches at #471: 142 more than the plain square (PE-DESIGN 118 more)
